scope: A3 pacing lower-bound model; not a player journey, not human approval

explore_first.order: locker -> crate01/02/03 -> cache1 -> home harvest -> stations -> cache2 -> research -> iron_pick
explore_first.route_order_note: Both orders use the same physical source set, costs and one cache cooldown; this model sums lower bounds and therefore reports identical totals. It proves order-invariant feasibility floors, not distinct measured pacing.
explore_first.travel_model: Manhattan lower bound at 96 px/s; not collision-verified BFS
explore_first.harvest_model: fresh A0 nodes; no offline respawn credit

20_min.goal: stone_pick + paid workbench + first scrap/oak/stone loop

45_min.goal: paid furnace + research_kit + first targeted research note

90_min.goal: iron_pick recipe learned and one physical iron_pick crafted

180_min.goal: repeat cache/deadfall, relay power, surplus ingots/spares, safe return and storage

bottlenecks: knowledge_spares still gate research_kit + basic-tool research
A0 must mount crate 02/03 interaction points and one-time receipts
stone_pick/iron_pick do not yet change A0 harvest; tool host contract required
real navigation/collision can increase travel lower bound
